source_caption_text:
AZ Chike opens up to about being in rooms with Kendrick Lamar, Pharrell and Tyler, The Creator, saying they treat him like he belongs and that he knows how to play his role.

“Man, me and Pharrell was talking about cold-cut sandwiches… That n***a don’t like no tomatoes. Can you believe it?!” Chike tells XXL’s @loshowco.

His new album No Rest for the Wicked is out today.
